method: SHA256 and byte comparison against issue-only transfer snapshot; to-do plan mapped to done; one exact review-path line replacement allowed. Git index blobs compared with every staged transferred file.
scope_limit: Does not inspect the original shared worktree or assert completeness of anything absent from the issue-only snapshot. File inventory is not a comprehensive secret scan.

files.change: approved worktree and archive review-path corrections only
